reviews.summary: 本次双语设备台账场景中，NocoBase3 的国际化链路（客户端语言资源、localStorage 持久化、会话级服务端语言、按 reason 映射错误文案）、HTTP API 错误契约（ApiError/ALREADY_EXISTS/fieldViolations）与数据层唯一约束都按文档正常工作，Agent 基本沿推荐入口实现，QA 复验 B01–B06 全部通过。已确认的主要不足是能力边界而非缺陷：语言选择存在会话上，同一账号的多个标签页会互相覆盖；国际化指引只示范了插件路由侧 AppI18nError→localizedMessage 的适配，应用自建路由需要自己写约 25 行适配器，本次应用因此完全改用客户端 reason 映射。另有两条指引可发现性小问题（示例文件两级目录、包内 dist/src 布局），只增加排查成本。

modules.name: 国际化：双语资源、语言切换与多语言文案
modules.scope: 客户端 locale 资源注册与切换、localStorage 持久化、服务端请求语言解析（会话 → Accept-Language → 默认）、错误文案的 language 归属，以及本次实际使用的 equipment.* / navigation.equipments 文案键。
modules.limitations: 未阅读 i18n core runtime 的完整实现（仅 middleware/session/errors 与 app-plugin-i18n 客户端实现）；未核实 app-plugin-i18n 服务端路由的完整测试路径。

requirements.need: 中英文界面切换：导航、表头、表单、按钮、系统状态、空列表说明都随语言变化，且不显示翻译键。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责语言注册表、切换时一次性加载所有 namespace、把选择写入 localStorage 并同步到服务端；应用负责提供两套 locale 文案与业务键。
requirements.recommendedUsage: i18n 指引说明语言列表就是应用自己的 client/locales 与 server/locales；插件 Skill 说明 setLocale 会并行加载全部 namespace、更新 <html lang>、写 localStorage 并 PUT /api/i18n/locale，且“不要自己写语言选择器，useAppLocale() 已有模板实现”。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 client/locales/en-US.ts 与 zh-CN.ts 中新增 navigation.equipments 与 equipment.* 键，沿用模板的语言开关，未自建 i18n 机制；QA B01/B04 在实际页面逐项核对通过。

requirements.need: 英文界面漏填必填项、提交重复编号时显示英文说明；切回中文后同一问题显示中文说明，不能暴露内部错误代码。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责稳定的错误契约（reason/domain/fieldViolations/localizedMessage）与按请求语言翻译的能力；应用负责把自己的 reason 映射到两种语言的用户文案，或抛出可翻译错误。
requirements.recommendedUsage: i18n 指引明确“前端不直接显示 message，而是把 status/reason 映射到自己的文案”；插件 Skill 规则进一步要求“不要基于已翻译文案分支，比较 reason”。服务端可选 AppI18nError→ApiError(localizedMessage) 适配。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在服务端定义 EQUIPMENT_CODE_TAKEN/fieldViolations，在客户端按 reason 映射中英文文案，与指引一致；未使用服务端 localizedMessage，因此服务端不产出已翻译文本。

requirements.need: 同一浏览器刷新后保留语言；一位同事切换语言不应影响另一位正在使用的同事。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责持久化与同步语义，并说明其边界；应用只调用受支持的 hook。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 插件 README 说明：选择写 localStorage 防刷新丢失，同时把语言存到 session 作为服务端应答语言；客户端用 useSyncServerLocale() 在启动时校正两者。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 使用模板语言开关（走 useAppLocale），QA B05（刷新后仍英文、数据不丢）与 B06（两个不同账号会话各自保持语言）通过。

requirementFit.reason: 双语资源注册、切换链、localStorage 持久化与按 reason 映射文案都被框架直接支持，本次六条验收中的语言类条目全部通过；扣分仅由于语言选择存放在会话上，同一账号多标签页会互相覆盖这一已文档化的边界。

usability.reason: useAppLocale()/useSyncServerLocale() 把“加载资源→切界面→写存储→通知服务端”封装成一次调用，模板已提供语言开关，应用只需提供文案；但服务端应用自建路由要拿到 localizedMessage 仍需自行编写序列化适配器。

agentFriendliness.reason: 插件 Skill 给出服务端翻译、AppI18nError 序列化、“不要按翻译文案分支”的完整规则，i18n 指引直接说明前端应映射 reason，Agent 据此实现且未反复试错；本模块在 9 个错误信号中未出现一次路径或 API 误用。

design.reason: 语言资源以包名注册、插件只提供翻译而不新增语言、overrides 让应用改写插件文案，边界清晰；AppI18nError 把“翻译发生在序列化时”做成显式抽象，避免在抛错处绑定语言。

reliability.reason: 已读 middleware/session 实现：会话不可读时退化为 Accept-Language 而非失败，缺少 translator 时抛出明确装配错误，AppI18nError 的 namespace/key/params 在序列化时才翻译；未读 core runtime 的资源回退实现，故未给更高分。

modules.name: HTTP API 契约：路由装配、错误体与输入校验
modules.scope: 本次涉及的 /api/equipments 路由声明、鉴权前置、错误体（ALREADY_EXISTS/EQUIPMENT_CODE_TAKEN、fieldViolations.code）、分页列表响应与描述文档声明。
modules.limitations: 未核验 OpenAPI 文档在运行实例中的实际输出，只读了 describeRoute/apiValidator 的类型与说明。

requirements.need: 重复编号必须被服务端真正拒绝并返回可区分、可本地化的错误，而不是前端拦截。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责标准错误体、状态码语义、字段级错误定位与 Repository 错误的统一识别；应用负责选择 reason/domain 并把业务规则落到数据库约束与路由。
requirements.recommendedUsage: http-api 指引给出 INVALID_ARGUMENT/FAILED_PRECONDITION/ALREADY_EXISTS/ABORTED 的语义分工，要求 reason 用 UPPER_SNAKE_CASE、domain 用应用自己的名字，客户端只按 reason 分支。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在路由中定义 equipmentCodeTakenError()（ALREADY_EXISTS + EQUIPMENT_CODE_TAKEN + domain nb3-factory + fieldViolations[{field:'code'}]），列表/详情分别用 listResponse/dataResponse 与 apiValidator；QA B03/B04 在实际双会话竞争下被拒绝且只保留一条记录。

requirements.need: 路由必须自行鉴定身份并保证未认证/未授权访问不会穿透。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责提供认证中间件与路由装配入口，并在文档中明确“挂在 /api 下不等于已认证”；应用负责在每条路由上声明。
requirements.recommendedUsage: defineApiRoutes() 装配 scope:'api' 的路由贡献；认证 token 从 @nocobase/app-plugin-authentication 取得，Skill 强调每条路由自己拥有鉴权。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 server/routes/equipments.ts 引入 authenticationToken 并通过 defineApiRoutes 挂载，路由内使用容器解析的服务；相关测试与 QA 通过。

requirementFit.reason: ALREADY_EXISTS(409) + 自定义 reason/domain + fieldViolations 正好表达“编号被占用且指向 code 字段”，无需自定义错误体；配套的 RepositoryError 识别让数据库层拒绝也能落入同一契约。

usability.reason: defineApiRoutes/dataResponse/listResponse/apiValidator/describeRoute 组合即可写出可文档化的路由，错误只需 throw new ApiError；迁移成本主要在多处样板（每个 target 一次 apiValidator）。

agentFriendliness.reason: http-api 指引以表格把 status 语义、domain 归属和 reason 规则写死，并给出既有错误示例；Agent 一次性选对 ALREADY_EXISTS 与 domain，未出现契约误用。

design.reason: 错误体采用 AIP-193 状态集并把 reason 与 message 的用途分离（客户端只依赖 reason），localizedMessage/metadata 作为可选扩展；recognizeApiError 把 ApiError、Hono HTTPException、4xx status 错误与 RepositoryError 统一到一个转换点。

reliability.reason: 实现上 toPayload 只输出声明字段，未识别错误一律转为不泄露内部信息的 500，RepositoryError 仅在非 INTERNAL 时透出 status/reason/metadata；未读 apiErrorHandler 的全部实现，故留有余量。

modules.name: 数据层：迁移、唯一约束与 Repository 访问
modules.scope: equipment 表的迁移（字段、长度、nullable、唯一约束 uq_equipment_code）、示例数据种子，以及服务层通过 Repository 的分页查询与唯一性判断。
modules.limitations: 未读迁移执行器与方言层的约束落库实现，只核对了公开定义与 Skill 示例的一致性。

requirements.need: 设备编号唯一，重复写入不能产生第二条记录；表结构可重复重建（新库迁移）。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责迁移定义形式、约束构建器与迁移不可变约定；应用负责声明唯一约束并决定业务校验。
requirements.recommendedUsage: nocobase-db Skill 的迁移示例直接演示 collection.string(...).notNull() 与 collection.unique('orderNo')，并强调迁移自包含、不导入演进的集合定义。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 的迁移把字段形状内联，并声明 collection.unique('code', { name: 'uq_equipment_code' })，与 Skill 示例同形；同时在 service 里加了一次预检查（应用侧冗余保护），真正兜底仍靠数据库约束。

requirements.need: 分页列表、按状态筛选、按 id 读取/更新，并准备两台示例设备。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 Repository 查询/计数与种子运行机制；应用负责过滤条件、排序与示例数据内容。
requirements.recommendedUsage: Repository 提供 findMany（返回可链式查询）/count/findOne/updateOne；Seed 用 defineSeed 声明，Skill 要求种子幂等并以唯一业务值做键。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 用 repository.findMany({filter, sort, limit, offset}) + repository.count 实现列表，用 defineSeed 写两台示例设备并在 QA 中可见。

requirementFit.reason: 唯一约束与分页查询都是框架既有能力，业务规则（编号唯一、状态枚举）由应用声明即落到数据库；应用侧额外预检查不改变框架满足度。

usability.reason: defineMigration/defineSeed 与链式约束构建器直观，Skill 给出可直接套用的骨架；但入库/查询 API 分散在 DatabaseManager、Repository、Seed 三处，Agent 需要多次 grep 才能确认 defineSeed 的用法。

agentFriendliness.reason: Skill 的迁移/种子示例与本次实现高度吻合，Agent 据此写出正确迁移；但 Agent 为确认 defineSeed 的上下文类型连续多次 grep 包内类型，说明类型提示对种子回调的帮助有限。

design.reason: 迁移定义自带 name/up/down 且要求自包含，种子有独立的运行/历史/修复语义（Seeder 接口区分 run/runSamples/repair），约束与索引通过 CollectionDefinitionBuilder 统一声明。

reliability.reason: 未阅读约束落库与迁移执行实现，只读了公开类型与 Skill 示例，按口径保留 null。

modules.name: 前端应用装配：路由、导航与 API 客户端

targets.name: app/.agents/skills/nocobase-app-development/references/frontend/references/api.md
entrypoints: 调用端点、错误处理与示例索引

modules.scope: 设备台账列表页与新建/编辑子路由的声明（navigation、authz、componentLoader）、页面数据加载走 useApiClient、表格/对话框等 UI 组合，以及导航项本地化。
modules.limitations: 未阅读路由解析与导航过滤的实现；未逐条核对表格组件的全部交互（排序、URL 过滤状态）是否在最终版本中落实。

requirements.need: 新增一个带导航入口的业务页面，含新建/编辑子页面，并受登录保护。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责路由/导航贡献模型、懒加载与鉴权继承；应用负责声明路由与页面组件。
requirements.recommendedUsage: page.md 要求在既有 defineAppRoutes([...]) 末尾追加条目、从 @nocobase/app-client/plugins 引入类型、用 componentLoader 懒加载、navigation 才产生菜单项。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 client/routes.ts 追加 equipments 路由（navigation、order 10、icon Package）与 equipment-new / equipment-edit 子路由，页面组件放在 client/pages/equipments/，与指引一致。

requirements.need: 页面通过 /api 读写设备数据，并把错误转换成界面文案。
requirements.responsibility: 框架负责 API 客户端的请求配置、错误类型（ApiClientError.reason）；应用负责调用与展示。
requirements.recommendedUsage: 指引要求页面用 useApiClient 加载数据，不依赖 Refine data provider；错误按 reason 分支并显示应用自己的文案。
requirements.actualUsage: Agent 在 client/pages/equipments/api.ts 用 useApiClient/ApiClientError 封装 list/create/get/update，并在表单层把 reason 映射为双语提示。

requirementFit.reason: 路由贡献、导航声明、鉴权模式与 useApiClient 足以表达本次页面与数据需求，且不需要改 shell；仅列表交互细节（URL 过滤、排序）由应用自行组合。

usability.reason: defineAppRoutes + componentLoader 的声明式模型装配成本低，类型把 navigation/authz/breadcrumb 一次讲清；但同一个功能分散在 routes.ts、pages/、locales/ 三处，缺少一处“最小页面清单”。

agentFriendliness.reason: page.md 与示例文件路径清晰，但示例位于 references/example/ 二级目录，Agent 按 references/list-page.md 取文件失败一次并转向其它路径；另有一次猜测客户端组件文件名失败。

design.reason: 路由定义与贡献解析分离（应用 defineAppRoutes、插件 defineClientPlugin），authz 支持继承与跳过，组件加载器保持懒加载；应用无需接触 shell 即可扩展菜单。

reliability.reason: 只读了公开导出与类型声明，未阅读路由解析/导航过滤实现，按口径保留 null。

findings.title: 语言切换被封装成一条完整链，应用只需提供两套文案
findings.detail: useAppLocale() 依次完成：并行加载所有 namespace 资源 → 切换界面并广播 i18next → 写 localStorage → PUT /api/i18n/locale；useSyncServerLocale() 在启动时校正浏览器与服务端会话的漂移。README 同时明确了失败语义：服务端不支持该语言时仍是成功结果（fallback: true），传输失败不回滚浏览器语言。
findings.impact: 本次应用没有自建 i18n 机制，也没有写语言选择器；刷新保留语言（B05）与两个账号各自保持语言（B06）都直接落在这条链上。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持现状；若后续支持“同账号多标签页各自语言”，需要动的是会话存储维度而不是这条链。

findings.title: 错误契约把“机器可判断”和“用户可读”分开，重复编号无需自定义响应体
findings.detail: ApiError 固定 status 映射（ALREADY_EXISTS=409）、reason/domain 分工、fieldViolations 与可选 localizedMessage/metadata；recognizeApiError 还把 RepositoryError（非 INTERNAL）转成同构错误，使数据库层拒绝与业务拒绝共用一套前端分支逻辑。
findings.impact: 应用只需定义一个 reason 常量就能同时满足“真正拒绝写入”“英文/中文提示”“指向 code 字段”三项要求，前端按 reason 分支而不解析 message。
findings.suggestedChange: 保持；若要进一步降低应用侧成本，可在 app-server 提供一个把 AppI18nError 转 ApiError 的默认 onError 适配器。

findings.title: 语言选择存在会话上，同账号多标签页会互相覆盖服务端语言
findings.detail: useAppLocale() 切换后把语言 PUT 到会话（LOCALE_SESSION_KEY='locale'），服务端随后按该值解析请求语言；README 的“已知限制”承认同一账号的多个标签页会互相覆盖：标签 A 切到中文，标签 B 的接口返回也变中文，而它的界面仍是英文。界面语言本身写在 localStorage，同样是浏览器维度共享。
findings.impact: 本次需求只要求“两位同事的独立会话互不影响”，用不同账号登录即可满足（B06 通过）；但同一人开两个标签页（常见用法）时，服务端返回文案与界面语言会不一致。

evidence.excerpt:
## Keeping the server in step

The browser is the source of truth for what it renders; the server keeps its own copy so it can answer in the right language. They drift apart routinely — a different browser, an expired session, a switch made in another tab.

`useSyncServerLocale()` sends the browser's language once at startup to reconcile them. It does not block rendering.

## Endpoints

```
GET /api/i18n/locales   → { data: { defaultLocale, locales: [{ locale, label, direction }] } }
PUT /api/i18n/locale    { locale } → { data: { locale, requestedLocale, fallback } }
```

Both sit under the application's base path, so an application served from `/main` answers at `/main/api/i18n/locale`. The session's language is a singleton setting, so it is replaced with `PUT`. It stores the requested language when supported and otherwise stores English (`en-US`), even if the configured default is another language; that fallback is a successful answer with `fallback: true`, not an error. A missing, empty or non-string `locale`, or any other body field, is answered `400` with reason `INVALID_INPUT` and a field violation in the standard error body.

`GET /api/i18n/locales` is listed in the application's API document at `/api/swagger/docs` under the `I18n` tag (`i18nListLocales`). `PUT /api/i18n/locale` is hidden from it: it stores a preference on the browser's cookie session for the application shell, and a caller with an API key has no session for it to change. What the server offers follows from the application's `server/locales/`; keeping it aligned with `client/locales/` is recommended, but a client-only language is allowed and does not prevent switching.

**A known limit:** the language is stored on the session, so tabs sharing an account overwrite each other. Tab A switching to Chinese means tab B's requests also come back in Chinese while its interface is still English. Error responses carry a stable `reason` alongside the translated `localizedMessage`, so a frontend can render errors in its own interface language from the reason regardless of what the session says.

evidence.excerpt:
# Rules

- **Never concatenate translated fragments.** Word order differs by language. Use interpolation: `t('greeting', { name })` against `'Hello {{name}}'`.
- **Test with the real runtime, not a mocked `t`.** Render components under `TestI18nProvider` with a runtime from `createTestI18nRuntime` (`@nocobase/i18n/testing`), built from the package's own locale files. It is strict by default, so a key missing from the fallback chain fails the test even when a `defaultValue` would have hidden it. Pass `defaultValue` only where a tree may genuinely render with no runtime mounted.
- **The loader key must be a runtime value.** `locales['en-US']()` written as a literal lets a bundler drop every other language from the build.
- **Outside a request, load the locale first.** In a background job or cron, `await i18n.ensureLocaleLoaded(locale)` before translating. Skipping it does not throw; translations quietly fall back.
- **`getFixedT` takes the namespace first.** `getFixedT(NS, locale)`; the other order binds a locale as a namespace and translates nothing.
- **Do not branch on a translated message.** Compare the error's `reason` (`ApiClientError.reason` in the browser); its `message` and `localizedMessage` change with the language.
- **Outbound content follows its recipient.** Mail and notifications take an explicit locale — the recipient's, not the locale of whoever triggered the work.

evidence.excerpt:
## Server-side text

API error messages, notifications and mail need translation too. The server translates them from `server/locales/`: `en-US.ts` states the wording and exports `AppServerResource`, and every other server locale is annotated with that type, so a key missing from one is a compile error. The template's server locales start empty — the server text that exists belongs to plugins — so add keys when the application's own endpoints start producing text. Name them by the same rules as client keys.

- The server resolves a request's language from the session's stored choice, then `Accept-Language`, then `i18n.defaultLocale`.
- Outbound content follows its recipient: mail, notifications and background work translate into the recipient's language, not the language of whoever triggered the work. A background job has no request to inherit a language from — resolve the recipient's locale explicitly and load it before translating. The `nocobase-app-plugin-i18n` Skill shows how server code translates, inside a request with `getRequestTranslator`, as an `AppI18nError` that the router's `onError` turns into an `ApiError` with a `localizedMessage`, and outside one with `getFixedT(namespace, locale)`.
- The frontend does not display an endpoint's `message` as is; it maps the status and the error's `reason` to its own copy (see [calling endpoints](frontend/references/api.md)).

## Keeping the server in step with the browser

`@nocobase/app-plugin-i18n` owns the language selector, persistence, and the server locale endpoints. The application shell calls `useSyncServerLocale()` so server messages use the browser's language when the server supports it; keep that call when changing the shell. If the server does not have that locale, the browser still switches and the server uses English; the language control shows an informational notice about the fallback.

## Which languages the application offers

The application's own locale files are the list. `client/locales/index.ts` decides what the browser offers and `server/locales/index.ts` what the server does, so adding a language means adding its file and loader entry on the side that needs it — there is no configured list to keep in step.

To add a language to the server, add its file annotated with `AppServerResource` (for example `server/locales/ja-JP.ts`) and its loader entry in `server/locales/index.ts`; the client side is described in [frontend copy and translations](frontend/references/i18n.md).

A plugin's locale file supplies translations for those languages, never a new one. A plugin shipping `ja-JP` to an application that does not offer Japanese puts nothing in the picker. Prefer keeping the client and server lists aligned when server-produced text needs the language. A client-only language is also valid: the interface switches to it, `PUT /api/i18n/locale` records English for the server, and the language control explains the fallback with an informational notice.

evidence.excerpt:
- **`status`** is one of a fixed set, and decides the HTTP status. Pick the one that matches:

  | `status`              | HTTP | Use for                                                   |
  | --------------------- | ---- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
  | `INVALID_ARGUMENT`    | 400  | The request itself is malformed or a field is invalid     |
  | `FAILED_PRECONDITION` | 400  | The request is valid, but the resource's state forbids it |
  | `UNAUTHENTICATED`     | 401  | No valid session or API key                               |
  | `PERMISSION_DENIED`   | 403  | Not allowed                                               |
  | `NOT_FOUND`           | 404  | Allowed, but the resource does not exist                  |
  | `ALREADY_EXISTS`      | 409  | Creating something that already exists                    |
  | `ABORTED`             | 409  | A concurrent change won, such as a version conflict       |
  | `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`  | 429  | A rate limit or quota                                     |
  | `INTERNAL`            | 500  | Never thrown on purpose; the application answers it       |
  | `UNAVAILABLE`         | 503  | A dependency is down; retrying later may succeed          |

  Two HTTP statuses exist outside this table, both as an `INVALID_ARGUMENT` that passes `httpStatus`: `413` for a request body over a size limit the route sets or the application's `api.bodyLimit` and `415` for an unsupported request content type. Nothing else overrides the status, and neither covers anything else: a generated output that grows too large is `400 FAILED_PRECONDITION`, and a file with the wrong extension is `400 INVALID_ARGUMENT`. There is no `422`: an invalid request is `INVALID_ARGUMENT` and a valid one the state forbids is `FAILED_PRECONDITION`, both `400`. There is no `502`: a failing upstream is `503 UNAVAILABLE`.

- **`domain`** is the namespace of whoever defined the reason: the plugin namespace, or the application's name for its own routes. The framework uses `app`. A plugin has one domain even when it serves several URL prefixes: every AI knowledge base error is `aiKnowledgeBases`. An error passed through from another plugin keeps the domain of the plugin that defined its reason, so the users plugin passing on `LAST_ASSIGNMENT` answers with domain `authorization`.
- **`message`** is an English sentence for developers. It is never shown to users.
- **`localizedMessage`**, `{ locale, message }`, is optional user-facing text the handler has already translated with the request's i18n.
- **`fieldViolations`**, `[{ field, description }]`, names the invalid fields of an `INVALID_ARGUMENT`.
- **`metadata`** carries further machine-readable facts about this occurrence.
